# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 19 Jul 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Launch & Land Sales
- **New condo sales hit a 2-year low in June with just 156 units sold** - The drop was driven entirely by a month with zero new project launches, rather than a collapse in demand; July launches are expected to bring a rebound. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/developers-new-home-sales-fall-to-a-2-year-low-in-june-rebound-expected-in-july/)
- **Bayshore Drive GLS site draws Singapore's largest-ever non-CBD land bid at $2.128 billion** - A Frasers Property-led joint venture topped the tender at $1,323 psf ppr, marking the first time a non-CBD government land sale plot has crossed the $2 billion mark. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/bayshore-lands-singapores-first-2-billion-non-cbd-gls-site/)
- **Gillman Barracks to become a new residential neighbourhood with heritage intact** - Plans call for both public and private homes on the site, with 25 heritage buildings and 8 hectares of greenery retained as part of the development. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/gillman-barracks-housing-estate/)

## HDB Resale Records
- **4-room flat at MacPherson Spring sets new Geylang district record at $1.1 million** - The unit at 82B Circuit Road sold in July 2026, surpassing the previous Geylang high by $12,000 despite being on a lower floor. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/4-room-hdb-flat-set-a-new-geylang-price-record-at-1-1m/)
- **2-room HDB national resale record broken as Queenstown flat sells for $696,000** - A high-floor unit at SkyParc @ Dawson is now the most expensive 2-room HDB flat ever sold on the resale market. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/2-room-national-record-broken-as-queenstown-unit-sells-for-s696000/)

## Rental & En Bloc
- **Condo and HDB rental market rebounds in June after a quiet May** - Both rents and transaction volumes moved higher across the board, according to the 99-SRX Rental Flash Report for June 2026. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-hdb-rental-market-rebound-june-2026/)
- **People's Park Centre launches third en bloc attempt at $1.48 billion — $320 million below previous asks** - The mixed-use Chinatown MRT site, Singapore's first-ever GLS parcel sold back in 1967, is back on the market with a significantly reduced guide price. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/peoples-park-centre-making-third-en-bloc-attempt-320-million-lower-price/)
